context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer CRUD bug fixes verified. Both bugs (MongoDB _id serialization and phone/contact field mapping) are fixed. All CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) work correctly with phone numbers. The frontend API layer in /src/api/customers.js handles the field mapping from 'contact' to 'phone'.

bug_1.root_cause: After inserting a customer document into MongoDB, the _id field (ObjectId) was included in the response. ObjectId is not JSON serializable, causing the API to fail.
bug_1.fix: Added customer.pop('_id', None) after insert_one() to remove the MongoDB _id before returning the response

bug_2.description: Editing customer not saving Contact Number
bug_2.root_cause: Field name mismatch - Frontend form used 'contact' field name, but backend expected 'phone' field. When updating, the contact value was sent as 'contact' but backend looked for 'phone', resulting in null values.
bug_2.fix: Added field mapping in frontend API layer: phone: data.contact || null
